local_review.review_comment: The diff is limited to org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-core:8.0.0.Beta1 support files. The javac repair is minimal: LoggerTest moves from the removed EmbeddableLoadingLogger to LoadingLogger.LOADING_LOGGER, and IdentifierGeneratorTest drops the SourceGeneration case because 8.0 removed that generator together with @Source. 59 new test classes, one per dynamic-access class, drive Hibernate's public bootstrap, configuration, query, mapping, and Session APIs against in-memory H2. Overall dynamic-access coverage rises from 55/413 (13.32%) on 7.1.0.Final to 231/446 (51.79%); reflection goes from 46/391 to 221/424 and resources from 9/22 to 10/22, so every scope passes the repair coverage gate. There are no Native Image skips, tolerated errors, version-pinned assertions, or legacy config files, and the inherited ServiceLoaderFeatureExcludeServices build argument and Graal substitutions are unchanged from 7.1.0.Final. The shipped metadata combines JVM-agent output with natively verified 8.0.0.Alpha1 entries carried forward for native-only hibernate-models paths, completed annotation attribute lists, and the serialization registrations Session serialization needs; PlanningOptions and FetchOptions are registered without a condition because GraalVM 25.0 rejects conditional record serialization registrations. All 137 native tests pass on the latest GraalVM with current and future defaults and on GraalVM 25.0.3, and checkMetadataFiles, Checkstyle, Spotless, and statistics generation pass. No blocking contribution-contract or test-contract violation was found.
